verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents an API reference and publishes its own public Postman workspace with organized collections, examples, environment variables and ready-to-use requests, so runnable examples exist. There is no evidence of an interactive in-docs API explorer or try-it console, so the story is only partly met. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API reference with runnable try-it examples, a published OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Our public workspace includes organized collections with examples, environment variables, and ready-to-use requests.
Import all Mailgun APIs into Postman for easy testing and integration.
